markScheme.exemplarAnswer: A grade 9 response will: argue media supports democracy (free press holds power to account, informs citizens, enables debate, investigative journalism exposes corruption); argue media undermines democracy (bias distorts public understanding, fake news misleads voters, social media abuse silences voices, concentration of media ownership limits diversity); evaluate: media is essential for democracy but requires regulation, media literacy and diversity of ownership to function properly; conclude: the media is a necessary but imperfect democratic institution - its benefits outweigh its harms when supported by regulation, media literacy and a critical citizenry.
